name: the Weighed Arch
descriptionSeed: The Masons put their gate a mile out and built a yard round it, because a thing that arrives from nowhere has not been weighed. Nothing enters Bedrock until the weigh-house has written it down. They are not suspicious of you; they are suspicious of anything that has not been measured, and you have not been yet.
appearance: A square yard of dressed stone around the gate arch, walled to shoulder height, every flag numbered. A weigh-house on the town side with a scale big enough for a cart and a ledger clerk who writes down what came through, how heavy it was, and what it said its business was.
encounterFlavor: A clerk weighing a crate twice because the first number was inconvenient; a Mason running a palm along the gate arch and frowning at a join nobody made; a Figurist envoy asking to be weighed in a unit that does not exist.
